headline: The tavern now makes heroes, not just replacements
lede: TEN-DEEP's third stage puts Wizardry's character sheet in the game: five races with gifts and bans, five classes with entry gates, alignments that move steel, and spellbooks that unlock by class and level — all seeded, all pinned, all ours.

notes.text: THE CREATE shipped: roll six papers at the Drowning Crow bench, shift a candidate's way (OATH/WANDER/RUIN) and watch the stat line recompose, accept for a flat 60g. Gates that read FAIL stay FAIL — a stoneborn DURROW may never throw fire.
Spells-by-level: FIREBOLT at 1, FIRESTORM at 5, WARD at 7, HEEL (subdue — the Hollow King refuses) at 9. New battle verbs: hold the shield (halves what it eats) and blind the dark for three rounds.

tendeepcheck 779/779 with 8/8 mutants caught (two new: a shield made of air, novice pyromancy); tendeepplay 46/46 real keys — the created hero matches the composed paper stat-for-stat, and a wipe-and-hire-and-create cycle still balances every coin.
A promise the bench must keep needs construction, not gambling: guaranteeing a MAGUS paper by rerolling failed 44% of seeds until the paper was built from the dice instead.
